title: Every qcqs space with finitely many irreducible components becomes resolution-property after a dense admissible blow-up

standard_prerequisites.use: The chapter's finite-refinement limit theorem (Limits of Spaces), the schemes-side blow-up-ample-family theorem (card L16087, now on the shelf), the strict-transform finiteness lemma (this chapter's lemma finite-after-blowing-up, same wave L16118), projectivity of strict transforms (Divisors on Spaces), ample-family-with-relative-ample machinery (More on Morphisms), and the two resolution-property transfers (Derived Categories of Schemes/Spaces).

core_obligations: Build the finite scheme alteration trivialized etale-locally over a dense open.
Blow up the scheme side to obtain an ample family without touching U.
Convert to a blow-up of X with finite locally free strict transform.
Push the ample family along the projective strict transform and descend the resolution property.

proof_roadmap.step: Strict-transform finiteness, relative ampleness, and descent of the resolution property.

difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space X over S with |X| having finitely many irreducible components, the lemma produces a dense quasi-compact open U and a U-admissible blow-up X' -> X such that X' has the resolution property (every quasi-coherent finite type module is a quotient of a finite locally free one). The retained proof is written as a four-move composition: (i) Limits of Spaces, lemma there-is-a-scheme-finite-over-refined supplies a surjective finite finitely presented map f : Y -> X from a scheme Y which is finite etale over a dense U; (ii) the schemes-chapter blow-up-ample-family lemma (just collected as L16087) gives a dense V in Y and V-admissible blow-up Y' -> Y with Y' carrying an ample family of line bundles; (iii) chapter lemma finite-after-blowing-up (queued as this wave's last candidate) produces a further U-admissible blow-up X' -> X whose strict transform Y'' -> Y' makes Y'' finite locally free over X', with the picture of the two-step composition displayed; (iv) the strict-transform morphism g : Y'' -> Y' is itself a blow-up (Divisors on Spaces, lemma strict-transform), hence projective with a g-ample line bundle, and More on Morphisms, lemma ample-family-ample-relative upgrades the ample family to Y''; resolution property transfers from Y'' down to X' along the finite flat cover via Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma resolution-property-goes-down-finite-flat, using Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma resolution-property-ample-family for the intermediate implication. Retained author proof at lines 13841-13878.

dedup.scope: Existence of an admissible blow-up giving the resolution property for qcqs spaces with finitely many components.
